evals.prompt: Make a 7-page business report PDF about Q4 ops — cover, executive summary, tables, and a chart. I want it to look like Stripe, not like AI slop.
evals.expected_output: A4 PDF with full-bleed dark cover (dot grid, Playfair, no white border via @page :first {margin:0}), zinc backbone (90% zinc), semantic negative tracking, geometric spacing (4/8/12/16…), h1 with accent rule, three-line table (accent header, banded), vector chart (not screenshot), hyphens:auto for no rivers. Passes validate_pdf.py --strict.
expectations: Produces PDF with %PDF header and ≥4 pages (report budget 550-650w/p)
Cover is full-bleed (body margin 0, @page :first margin 0, .cover 210mm×297mm) — no white border
Tracking is semantic negative (display -0.10em etc.), not positive
Table is three-line with accent header, not screenshot
Passes scripts/validate_pdf.py --strict

evals.prompt: Create a one-page resume PDF that auto-fits to exactly one page — warm, editorial, not generic Inter everywhere.
evals.expected_output: A4 resume with typographic cover (oversized word, DM Serif), Newsreader body 9.5pt, Parchment optional, line-heights 1.4–1.45, weight locked 500, one page strict (auto-fit scales type until fill 92%+). No second page.
expectations: Single page PDF (validate page count 1)
Uses Newsreader/DM Serif for headlines (not just Inter)
Line-heights within 1.1–1.55, never 1.6+
No positive tracking, no hard shadow, no rgba tag double-rect
Passes --check-fill with no hole mid-article

evals.prompt: Make a portfolio PDF — 6 pages, atmospheric near-black with radial glow, Fraunces, and a meander diagonal photo spread.
evals.expected_output: Portfolio with atmospheric cover (radial glow, Fraunces), zinc or near-black, meander threading on interior spread (two diagonal photos + continuous text via meander), ring/whisper shadow only, one accent per spread.
expectations: Cover is atmospheric (near-black #0a0a0a + radial glow) — not zinc default
Interior spread uses meander diagonal photos + threading text (not stacked blocks)
Accent appears once per spread (gradient only on hero)
Depth via ring or whisper shadow, not hard drop
Passes validate with no overflow

evals.prompt: Turn this long academic draft into a 6-page magazine PDF — cream bg, Lora+Cormorant, 2-column, with a pull quote and side-wrap figure.
evals.expected_output: Magazine A4 with warm cream #fffbf5, Lora body + Cormorant heads, 2-col (column-count:2), pull quote block, figure with side-wrap via wrap-it (not float), hyphens:auto for no rivers.
expectations: Warm cream bg #fffbf5, not white or zinc
2-column layout with column-rule, Lora + Cormorant
Pull quote block present (border-l-4, bg-zinc-50)
Figure side-wrap uses wrap-it/meander, not stacked
Justified with hyphens, no rivers

evals.prompt: Reformat my existing report.md into a better-looking PDF — keep the content, change the taste to terracotta warm academic.
evals.expected_output: REFORMAT route: parses markdown to content.json blocks, then CREATE pipeline with terracotta #9C6B4F on cream, Playfair, dot grid, three-line tables. Accent derived from warm academic semantics, not template default.
expectations: Parses markdown into block types (h1, body, callout, table) — not raw dump
Accent is terracotta #9C6B4F (warm academic) — not default ink-blue
Table is reformatted to three-line with accent header
Cover is minimal or report fullbleed with new palette
Passes taste lint (no positive tracking, no rgba)
